page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s2.xlarge is an x86_64 virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.s2 family, running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 dedicated physical CPU cores with a single thread per core, providing 2 vCPUs. The instance is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, resulting in a memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per core.

This instance configuration does not include local storage, requiring network-attached block storage for data persistence. It contains no GPU accelerators and provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The underlying CPU lacks support for advanced instruction sets, including Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX, AVX512), Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), cryptographic acceleration (AES, SHA_NI), and hardware virtualization (VMX, SVM).

With its dedicated CPU allocation and standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.s2.xlarge offers a predictable resource profile for entry-level workloads. The absence of specialized hardware accelerators and advanced instruction sets limits its utility for high-performance computing, cryptography, or machine learning. It is best suited for lightweight applications, basic web serving, and development environments that require dedicated CPU resources without complex computational demands.
